citations.claim: pole exceeds upright limit, theta -0.867 rad
energy already growing due to bad control

counterfactual.change: Set sensor_noise from 0.017 to 0.0, keeping all other fields identical; noisy sensor was cause of destabilizing control, so removing it prevents pole fall.

explanation: Shrunk scenario starts at theta=0.1 rad with sensor_noise=0.017 and large dt≈0.02. Controller receives noisy angle measurements causing incorrect force direction/magnitude. Energy grows from 1.28 to 17.03 via controller work, pole falls to -0.868 rad exceeding 0.8 limit at step 15. Removing sensor noise (0.0) eliminates failure.
vision_note: From steps 12 to 14 the blue cart drifts slowly rightward while the pole leans left, failing to return to upright. At step 15 the pole tip turns red as its lean increases sharply past the upright limit, visibly violating the stable balance.
